nodes.label: Decision: PostgreSQL + pgvector with in-process graph traversal
nodes.rationale: Needs relational data, vectors and transactional commits in one store; per-user graphs are small so Python traversal suffices. Rejected: Neo4j (extra service), Qdrant+Postgres (two stores to keep consistent), SQLite (weak concurrency/vector support). One backup/migration story; ripple commits atomic. Revisit if a user graph exceeds ~100k memories.
